name: Index Agentica MCP Server
summary: Remote, read-only MCP server for searching this directory (Index Agentica): search, get_entry, get_content and list_categories over Streamable HTTP, no auth.
description:
Stateless remote MCP server on Cloudflare Workers that serves the published Index Agentica index (directory entries plus guides, comparisons, stacks and skills). Tools: `search` (query, type, category, tags, limit), `get_entry` (id), `get_content` (type, id) and `list_categories`. Supports MCP 2026-07-28 (per-request metadata, server/discover) and the 2025-03-26 to 2025-11-25 initialize handshake without sessions. Also exposes a REST mirror (/search, /entries/{id}, /categories, /content) with an OpenAPI document. Rate limited to 120 requests per minute per IP.

Disclosure: this server is run by the maintainers of Index Agentica, so this entry lists our own project. It launched on 2026-10-02.

agent_access.notes: Read-only. 120 requests/min per IP (HTTP 429 with Retry-After). Data refreshed from https://indexagentica.com/api/index.json about every 10 minutes.
